doc: Synthetic drawables for run_tests.py. Each test converts res/drawable/<name>.xml (resources resolved in res/), compares the JSON with ref/<name>.json, checks json2rc and the Java parser give identical bytes, and renders frames with the TypeScript player against the oracle. options: extra converter options.

tests.name: static_icon
tests.features: group transforms, even-odd fill, clip-path, linear and radial gradients, theme stroke, arcs

tests.name: spinner
tests.features: infinite rotation, linear interpolator, theme tint

tests.name: trim_progress
tests.features: trimPathStart / End / Offset with wrapping windows, path interpolator starting with L

tests.name: checkbox_morph
tests.features: sequential pathType morphs (pathTween chain), fillAlpha repeat reverse, keyframes with missing fraction and per-keyframe interpolators

tests.name: color_fade
tests.features: colour keyframes (two-layer mix, linear-light warp), stroke colour from transparent, root alpha

tests.name: motion_path
tests.features: propertyXName / propertyYName along a cubic path

tests.name: interpolators
tests.features: overshoot, anticipate-overshoot, bounce, cycle with repeat

tests.name: spinner
tests.features: --trigger: start time from a named variable, click replays
